company.name: Skeps
company.shortDescription: Next generation Pay-Over-Time solutions for merchants and lenders.
company.description: Skeps is a modular suite of products that can be used by merchants or lenders to help identify the potential credit solutions for their customers with the highest likelihood of conversion. Skeps products can be native to the client environment and give access to rich data that can be used to provide highly customized customer offers while still following privacy guidelines. Skeps private blockchain technology allows for simultaneous evaluation of multiple financing options leading to reduced declines and improved customer experience. The company was founded in 2018 with headquarters in the U.S. and offices in India. Learn more at www.skeps.com.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $9,495,791, or 38.61% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,143,539 to $98,521,812, a 12.1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 86 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
